en: Black‑and‑white view from a terrace with ornate balustrades and gas‑style streetlamps, showing an equestrian statue on a richly decorated pedestal in the foreground. Below is a formal garden and steps with several women in long dresses and hats, suggesting early 20th‑century fashion. In the background, across a wide river, stands a grand suspension bridge with stone towers leading into a dense cityscape of classical buildings stretching along the riverbank.
